en: Black‑and‑white winter photograph of a group of women and children standing in the snow in front of a large two‑storey wooden house with clapboard siding and a picket fence. Bare trees and snow-covered ground suggest a cold northern climate. The house has tall rectangular windows and a small storefront-like entrance on the left side, with signage visible in the lower window. More wooden houses stretch along the street in the background.
